say:1:1230240001:1.text: You aren't the first to say that, and I admit the advice is sound most of the time.
say:1:1230240001:1.source_cn: 很多人都这样劝过我，我也承认，他们很多时候都是正确的。
say:1:1230240001:1.male: You aren't the first to say that, and I admit the advice is sound most of the time.
say:1:1230240001:1.female: You aren't the first to say that, and I admit the advice is sound most of the time.

say:2:1230240002:1.text: Still, I want to give it a shot, even if their warnings turn out to be true.
say:2:1230240002:1.source_cn: 但我想试试，哪怕试过之后的事实证明，他们确实没错。
say:2:1230240002:1.male: Still, I want to give it a shot, even if their warnings turn out to be true.
say:2:1230240002:1.female: Still, I want to give it a shot, even if their warnings turn out to be true.

say:3:1230240003:1.text: Staying here alone and getting involved in gang conflicts might be the "safer" option...
say:3:1230240003:1.source_cn: 可现在“安全”地守在这里，一个人从天亮到天黑，参与帮派...
say:3:1230240003:1.male: Staying here alone and getting involved in gang conflicts might be the "safer" option...
say:3:1230240003:1.female: Staying here alone and getting involved in gang conflicts might be the "safer" option...

say:4:1230240004:1.text: But it might not be the kind of life I truly desire!
say:4:1230240004:1.source_cn: 这也未必是我想要的生活！
say:4:1230240004:1.male: But it might not be the kind of life I truly desire!
say:4:1230240004:1.female: But it might not be the kind of life I truly desire!
